# Standcast

> Standcast orchestrates a team daily standup from GitHub to Slack or Google Chat. Each person writes their daily with their AI agent, starting from a draft of their GitHub activity, and Standcast posts one digest per team to Slack or Google Chat. The public API is read-only; dailies are sent through the MCP server or the CLI.

## Documentation

- [Docs index for agents](https://docs.standcast.app/llms.txt): every documentation page as Markdown
- [Full docs in one file](https://docs.standcast.app/llms-full.txt): the whole documentation in a single file

## API

- [API index for agents](https://api.standcast.app/llms.txt): OpenAPI document, reference and webhooks guide
- [Changelog of the API](docs/api/CHANGELOG.md): changes to the public API contract

## Repository

- [README](README.md): what the project is and how to run it
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to work on the repository
- [Review guide](docs/engineering/review-guide.md): what reviewers check before merging. Product changes and public API changes are written separately, before the pull request merges. Product: one bullet under `Unreleased` in `docs/site/changelog.md` and the same news under `Não lançado` in `docs/site/pt-BR/changelog.md`. A release with no product note fails. API contract: one bullet under `Unreleased` in `docs/api/CHANGELOG.md`. An empty API section is published as no public API change.
